# Titanix

> Titanix is a product studio (est. 2021) that designs and ships iOS apps, SaaS platforms, and IoT systems — from bare metal and embedded firmware to the App Store and cloud. Website: https://www.titanix.dev

## What we do

- **iOS Apps** — Native iOS applications in Swift & SwiftUI: on-device and cloud AI, WidgetKit, Live Activities, StoreKit subscriptions, full App Store launches.
- **SaaS Platforms** — End-to-end web products: auth, billing, multi-tenant dashboards, APIs, real-time data. Typical stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Stripe.
- **IoT Systems** — Hardware + software: embedded firmware, LoRa/edge networks, sensor data pipelines, live telemetry.

## Shipped products

- **Lovly** (iOS, Lifestyle/Social) — couples app with a shared drawing canvas, moods and love notes on each partner's Lock Screen. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760272304
- **Memopix** (iOS, Photo & Video) — turns 20-60 photos into shaped photo-collage keepsakes, print-ready as PNG, JPEG or PDF. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789686385
- **Qaza Qada: Missed Salah** (iOS, Lifestyle) — estimates missed prayers, builds a make-up plan, and keeps the remaining count on the Lock Screen; also daily verses, offline prayer times, Qibla and Tasbih. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757791803
- **Aer: Air Quality** (iOS, Weather/Health) — live AQI for 35 cities in North Macedonia with a 7-day Copernicus (CAMS) forecast, alerts and widgets. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790945433
- **Pet Portraits** (iOS, AI) — turns one dog or cat photo into gallery-grade AI portraits and animated Living Portraits. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793742748
- **skeniraj.mk** (SaaS, Hospitality) — QR-menu platform for restaurants and hotels with a multi-tenant dashboard and billing. https://skeniraj.mk
